text:
maya: FYI saw a pattern where quick reconnect+resume causes duplicated trailing tokens. Likely proxy returns resume accepted before runtime has committed session state.
ron: Repro'd on staging: disconnect, reconnect within 300ms, sometimes last chunk repeats. Logs: 
```
[12:10:02] conn=qwe123 tenant=t-56 seq=88
[12:10:04] conn=qwe123 -> TCP CLOSE
[12:10:04] reconnect resume_token=rt-22 -> proxy: resume accepted (s=zz)
[12:10:04] runtime: cache miss for s=zz -> re-eval seq=88 -> emit seq=88 (duplicate)
```
elena: Key question: does the proxy acceptance imply runtime consistency? Right now no. We need a robust handshake.
chris: Proposal: two-phase resume handshake. Proxy -> client: provisional accept with nonce. Runtime must ack confirm before proxy treats session as fully resumed. If confirm delayed >250ms, proxy emits control/backoff event.
maya: For SSE, in-stream event examples: 
```
event: resume
data: {"status":"provisional","nonce":"n-42"}

event: resume
data: {"status":"confirmed","nonce":"n-42","last_seq":89}
```
For WS: JSON frames like: `{"event":"resume","status":"provisional","nonce":"n-42"}` then confirm frame.
ron: Also add an explicit control/backoff event for soft-throttle: 
SSE:
```
event: control
data: {"type":"backoff","backoff_ms":500,"reason":"session_pending"}
```
WS: `{ "event":"control","type":"backoff","backoff_ms":500 }`
elena: Telemetry additions: resume_phase (provisional|confirmed|expired), resume_nonce, resume_confirm_latency_ms, duplicate_emitted (true|false), billed_during_provisional (true|false). Also add control_event_sent boolean.
chris: Billing change: do not bill tokens emitted during provisional window unless confirm is received. If confirm fails, mark those tokens as waived. Need DB flag for provisional_token_batch.
maya: SDK changes: when provisional state received, SDK should queue outgoing user input until confirmed, or present a clear UI state. Document behavior for default SDKs: queue for up to 250ms then NACK.
sdk-team: Will update JS/Go SDKs to honor provisional status and to expose resume state to app authors. We'll also add opt-in for aggressive low-latency mode that skips confirm (for internal/low-risk tenants).
ops-bot: Alert generated: resume_duplicate_detected spike for tenant t-56 at 12:10 (4 events).
deploy-bot: Canary: routing v4.1 -> 25% (2026-03-12T12:00Z).
ron: Small implementation note: proxy must tag accepts with nonce and keep a short-lived mapping until confirm/timeout. Use LRU cache with TTL <= 1s.
elena: Edge case: some CDNs coalesce SSE packets. To be resilient add an extra newline separator and unique `id` per control event and ensure clients parse by newline+id.
maya: UX: console should show per-session resume_state (provisional/confirmed/failed), last_seq, and a resume latency histogram. Add a chart for provisional->confirm ratio.
chris: Short-term mitigation: flip feature flag to require runtime-confirm for all prod tenants while we roll out. Longer term implement provisional flow + billing protection + SDK changes.
ron: Action items:
- ron: feature-flag flip + dashboard annotation (PR)
- elena: spec for two-phase resume + control event schema (PR)
- chris: billing waiver implementation plan + telemetry schema (PR)
- sdk-team: SDK support for provisional state + queuing (PR)
- QA: e2e harness simulating runtime delays 100-500ms (ticket)
maya: Please paste PR/ticket links here when created. Scheduling 15min sync 09:30 to decide on flag and rollout. :calendar:
